facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.summarize_ade20k_categories: summarize the 847 ADE20K-Full semantic segmentation categories with their names, ids, and train ids
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.review_ade20k_registration: review the ADE20K-Full dataset registration logic including image and annotation directory paths
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.refactor_ade20k_meta: refactor the ADE20K-Full metadata generation to support custom category mappings or subsets

facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.register_ade20k_instance_dataset: register the ADE20K instance segmentation dataset splits with detectron2 using a custom root directory
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.get_ade_instances_meta: get the ADE20K instance metadata including contiguous ID mapping and 100 thing class names
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.review_ADE_CATEGORIES: review the 100 ADE20K category definitions with their IDs and names for instance segmentation

facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.summarize_register_ade20k_instance: summarize how the ADE20K instance dataset is auto-registered on import using the DETECTRON2_DATASETS environment variable

facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.load_ade20k_panoptic_json: load ADE20K panoptic JSON annotations into Detectron2 standard dataset format with image and label paths
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.register_ade20k_panoptic: register an ADE20K panoptic segmentation dataset with DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for a given split
facebookresearch_mask2former/mask2former.get_metadata: get ADE20K metadata including thing and stuff class names, colors, and dataset-to-contiguous ID mappings
